method: Cited public signal families only; budgets are original editorial heuristics, not verified platform limits or recommendation coefficients. Unknown networks use conservative generic guidance. Trending evidence is local owner-supplied data, never fetched or independently attested by this CLI.

default.description: No verified ranking model; keep topic labels sparse, literal and relevant.
creative_checks: State one authentic audience problem and a verifiable result.
Use clear accessible content with honest keywords.
Evaluate matched-age first-party outcomes; do not infer reach from a tag.

sources.title: General audience relevance policy (repository editorial guidance)

linkedin.description: Professional-topic relevance and useful discussion; March 2026 AI-based feed matching.
creative_checks: Start with the exact professional problem and a true outcome.
Demonstrate a real case study or result; remove engagement bait.
Use an accurate, specific first line and answer substantive replies.

instagram.description: Original, audience-relevant visual education; no verified universal hashtag boost.
creative_checks: Make original visual proof clear in the first seconds or carousel card.
Use accurate captions, legible overlays and appropriate accessibility.
Review retention, saves and shares from the actual account.

tiktok.description: Personalized For You recommendations; watch-through and viewer interactions frequently dominate metadata.
creative_checks: Demonstrate the real result immediately; keep spoken and on-screen claims aligned.
Write searchable plain-language caption; add only on-topic hashtags.
Compare completion, skip, replay and meaningful viewer actions using native insights.

sources.title: TikTok Creative Center trend analytics, July 2026

youtube.description: Viewer satisfaction and click/watch behavior; video tags have minimal discovery role except misspellings.
creative_checks: Use an accurate searchable title and credible thumbnail.
Deliver title's promise early and check audience retention/skip segments.
Check native impressions-to-watch and qualified visits; tags alone are not a strategy.

threads.description: Relevant native topics and authentic conversations; Meta reported association, not causal lift.
creative_checks: Choose one truly relevant native topic label.
Lead with an independently useful observation.
Measure discussions and native discovery; do not infer a guaranteed boost.

x.description: Interest-related discovery and conversation; production ranking weights unknown.
creative_checks: Start with one verifiable finding, visual or reproducible lesson.
Prefer a clear first sentence and purposeful thread if needed.
Measure genuine interactions, not automated engagement.

bluesky.description: Custom user-controlled feeds and chronological Following; hashtags are feed-specific discovery cues.
creative_checks: Use an accurate technical keyword and accessible context.
Find relevant opt-in developer feeds without mass mentions.
Participate in substantive discussion.

mastodon.description: Federated timelines/instances; descriptive tags assist discovery but no universal reach model.
creative_checks: Use a few descriptive terms appropriate to your instance and audience.
Provide alt text for diagrams and a complete standalone explanation.
Respond to real questions, not automated mass mentions.

facebook_pages.description: Original useful content prioritized over shallow copies; page audience and eligibility matter.
creative_checks: Use original footage or a distinctive demonstration.
Explain why the post solves a user problem.
Compare real engagement/qualified referrals for each Page.

pinterest.description: Search-led visual discovery; keyword relevance in titles and image descriptions matters more than a hashtag recipe.
creative_checks: Write the task/benefit in the Pin's title and description.
Use an original high-resolution explanatory image and accurate board.
Check native outbound clicks and save rate.

xiaohongshu.description: Regionally localized discovery; public verified algorithm weights unavailable.
creative_checks: Write accurate Simplified-Chinese searchable problem and result.
Create original legible images/short demo with clearly explained steps.
Verify current native composer, tag usage and analytics manually.

sources.title: Xiaohongshu official platform homepage (not ranking evidence)

bilibili.description: Video and community discovery; current ranking weights not publicly verified in this register.
creative_checks: Produce a clear subtitled demonstrable result.
Localize terminology accurately for Chinese-language viewers.
Check retention and genuine technical questions from first-party creator insights.

douyin.description: Video recommendation behavior can change; no verified Douyin-specific weighting model here.
creative_checks: Use an original visible demonstration, not copied trends.
Write accurate Chinese captions and context.
Collect real native retention and audience-activity evidence where permitted.

sources.title: Douyin official open platform (API, not algorithm evidence)

weibo.description: Topic and conversation discovery; no verified ranking coefficients.
creative_checks: Write an accurate short headline and native-language context.
Use tags only for directly related topics.
Measure real referrals and substantive comments.

sources.title: Weibo open platform (API, not ranking evidence)

zhihu.description: Search, useful expert explanations and Q&A context rather than hashtag stuffing.
creative_checks: Address a genuine technical question with reproducible steps.
Cite primary sources and avoid over-promotional answers.
Measure useful responses and relevant visits.

dev.description: Useful original technical tutorials and topical tags; no proprietary ranking formula established.
creative_checks: Give runnable steps, practical caveats and sources.
Use only relevant technical publication tags chosen by a human.
Follow DEV's community rules; no automated comments.
